windows.limits: Endpoint edge-count rates are quantized by approximately one edge per window. Periods/widths count sampled PCLK cycles and update only on their defining edge; sticky valid bits retain historical measurements. Frequencies use nominal27MHz and snapshot acknowledgment epochs with unmeasured CDC latency variation. The most recent complete VS interval can start before this window; no full-window geometry or pixel proof.
